prompts.name: montanha-1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game sprite, isolated on true transparent background. Pianco Ferro e Mandacaru, Brazilian Paraiba dry sertao 1930s. Hand-painted detailed naturalistic RTS art matching the viewed reference buildings: earthy subdued colors, fine brushwork, readable at 80x112 pixels, NOT pixel art, NOT cartoon, NOT a 1998 game. Orthographic top-down three-quarter camera over ORTHOGONAL square grid, front is image bottom. ONE tall massive outcrop of warm gray beige granite: rises vertically like a section of a rugged Brazilian granite mountain massif, broad exposed rock face, inclined weathered slabs, deep fissures, irregular rounded jagged crest, very sparse dry olive vegetation in cracks. NOT a little pile of loose stones. NOT a rectangular box, cylinder, pillar or separate pedestal. Shape broad enough to interlock and overlap adjacent mountain blocks. Silhouette fills a tall 5:7 framing, rock height approximately 1.5 ground tiles; lowest foot centered horizontally, ground contact base 80 percent of overall width, upper rock can overhang slightly. Entire object visible with a thin transparent margin; no ground patch. Lighting ONLY overhead and slightly from FRONT/SOUTH, exactly zero east-west directional bias: left and right equally lit, upward/front surfaces brighter, deep cracks dark. No cast shadow, no text, no border, no decoration.
Variant: No mineral. Tall broken rounded crest with a large central sloping slab and branching vertical cracks.

processing: Copy original outputs without modification to originais/; base.png is original montanha-1, without reduction.
Crop transparent margins using alpha>=16 for framing; Lanczos resize to 104 px high, at most 80 px wide; bottom-center placement on 80x112 RGBA.
No mineral painted procedurally; all rock and veins generated by native image tool.
Proof uses exact sprites and original areia.png at 64 px pitch, rows north to south; grid 5x4, 3 iron and 2 gold.

visual_review.assessment: Massivo rochoso continuo com veios na face; repeticao de algumas cristas visivel. Candidato, sem homologacao do operador.
visual_review.lighting: Prompt exige luz superior/sul sem componente leste-oeste; a inspecao visual nao mede fisicamente o campo de iluminacao.
